title: China hits back at US claims of 'malicious' AI distillation ahead of planned Trump-Xi talks
description: China has dismissed U.S. claims that Chinese artificial intelligence developers extract capabilities from frontier American AI systems. On Wednesday, China's Commerce Ministry said the U.S. accusations were groundless. Its Ministry of Foreign Affairs urged the U.S. to avoid making unfounded accusations and insisted its AI development is self-reliant. The U.S. allegations were made in a joint cybersecurity advisory by the FBI, NSA, and Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency. They named six Chinese AI developers, including DeepSeek, Alibaba and Moonshot AI, saying they gain unauthorized access to U.S. AI models and that the Chinese government is aware. AI governance is expected to come up in talks planned between U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping.
content:
BANGKOK (AP) — China hit back Wednesday against U.S. claims that Chinese artificial intelligence developers are engaged in “aggressive, malicious” industrial-scale efforts to extract capabilities from frontier American AI systems.
